\"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Types to represent unstructured mesh elements\nusing idx_t = uint64_t;\nusing val_t = double;\n\n// Maximum number of connections per element (for a 2D grid: 4 // External energy source/sink\n};\n\n// Static connectivity information for each element\nstruct ElementStatic {\n    idx_t material_idx;\n    idx_t num_connections;\n    idx_t elements_static;\n    std::vector<ElementDynamic> elements_dynamic;\n    std::vector<ElementDynamic> elements_dynamic_swap;\n};\n\n// Material type IDs\nconstexpr idx_t DEFAULT_MAT_ID = 0;\nconstexpr idx_t INFLOW_MAT_ID = 1;\nconstexpr idx_t OUTFLOW_MAT_ID = 2;\n\n// Build a 2D square grid as an unstructured mesh\n// This represents computation on arbitrarily-shaped geometries\nvoid buildSquare2D(World& world, const int n_elems_root) {\n    const int n_elems = n_elems_root * n_elems_root;\n    \n    // Initialize materials\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, 0.0});    // Default material\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, 0.5});    // Inflow material\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, -0.5});   // Outflow material\n    \n    // Allocate elements\n    world.elements_static.resize(n_elems);\n    world.elements_dynamic.resize(n_elems);\n    world.elements_dynamic_swap.resize(n_elems);\n    \n    // Initialize all elements with default material and zero energy\n    for (int i = 0; i < n_elems; ++i) {\n        world.elements_static[i].material_idx = DEFAULT_MAT_ID;\n        world.elements_static[i].num_connections = 0;\n        world.elements_dynamic[i].current_energy = 0.0;\n        world.elements_dynamic[i].total_flux = 0.0;\n    }\n    \n    // Build connectivity: each element connects to its neighbors in 2D grid\n    for (int x = 0; x < n_elems_root; ++x) {\n        for (int y = 0; y < n_elems_root; ++y) {\n            const int idx = x * n_elems_root + y;\n            ElementStatic& elem = world.elements_static[idx];\n            \n            // Connect to neighbors (up, down, left, right)\n            const int offsets[4][2] = {{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}};\n            \n            for (int n = 0; n < 4; ++n) {\n                const int nx = x + offsets[n][0];\n                const int ny = y + offsets[n][1];\n                \n                // Check if neighbor is within bounds\n                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n_elems_root && ny >= 0 && ny < n_elems_root) {\n                    const int neighbor_idx = nx * n_elems_root + ny;\n                    elem.connected_idx[elem.num_connections] = neighbor_idx;\n                    elem.connected_flux[elem.num_connections] = 1.0;\n                    elem.num_connections++;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Set corner elements as inflow/outflow to create interesting dynamics\n    const int last = n_elems_root - 1;\n    world.elements_static[0 * n_elems_root + 0].material_idx = INFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    world.elements_static[0 * n_elems_root + last].material_idx = OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    world.elements_static[last * n_elems_root + 0].material_idx = OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;\n \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Types to represent unstructured mesh elements\nusing idx_t = uint64_t;\nusing val_t = double;\n\n// Maximum number of connections per element (for a 2D grid: 4 neighbors)\nconstexpr int MAX_CONNECTIONS = 8;\n\n// Material properties for energy transfer\nstruct Material {\n    val_t transfer_coeff;  // Energy transfer coefficient\n    val_t external_flow;   // External energy source/sink\n};\n\n// Static connectivity information for each element\nstruct ElementStatic {\n    idx_t material_idx;\n    idx_t num_connections;\n    idx_t connected_idx[MAX_CONNECTIONS];     // Indices of connected elements\n    val_t connected_flux[MAX_CONNECTIONS];    // Flux coefficients for each connection\n};\n\n// Dynamic state for each element\nstruct ElementDynamic {\n    val_t current_energy;\n    val_t total_flux;\n};\n\n// World state\nstruct World {\n    std::vector<Material> materials;\n    std::vector<ElementStatic> elements_static;\n    std::vector<ElementDynamic> elements_dynamic;\n    std::vector<ElementDynamic> elements_dynamic_swap;\n};\n\n// Material type IDs\nconstexpr idx_t DEFAULT_MAT_ID = 0;\nconstexpr idx_t INFLOW_MAT_ID = 1;\nconstexpr idx_t OUTFLOW_MAT_ID = 2;\n\n// Build a 2D square grid as an unstructured mesh\n// This represents computation on arbitrarily-shaped geometries\nvoid buildSquare2D(World& world, const int n_elems_root) {\n    const int n_elems = n_elems_root * n_elems_root;\n    \n    // Initialize materials\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, 0.0});    // Default material\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, 0.5});    // Inflow material\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, -0.5});   // Outflow material\n    \n    // Allocate elements\n    world.elements_static.resize(n_elems);\n    world.elements_dynamic.resize(n_elems);\n    world.elements_dynamic_swap.resize(n_elems);\n    \n    // Initialize all elements with default material and zero energy\n    for (int i = 0; i < n_elems; ++i) {\n        world.elements_static[i].material_idx = DEFAULT_MAT_ID;\n        world.elements_static[i].num_connections = 0;\n        world.elements_dynamic[i].current_energy = 0.0;\n        world.elements_dynamic[i].total_flux = 0.0;\n    }\n    \n    // Build connectivity: each element connects to its neighbors in 2D grid\n    for (int x = 0; x < n_elems_root; ++x) {\n        for (int y = 0; y < n_elems_root; ++y) {\n            const int idx = x * n_elems_root + y;\n            ElementStatic& elem = world.elements_static[idx];\n            \n            // Connect to neighbors (up, down, left, right)\n            const int offsets[4][2] = {{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}};\n            \n            for (int n = 0; n < 4; ++n) {\n                const int nx = x + offsets[n][0];\n                const int ny = y + offsets[n][1];\n                \n                // Check if neighbor is within bounds\n                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n_elems_root && ny >= 0 && ny < n_elems_root) {\n                    const int neighbor_idx = nx * n_elems_root + ny;\n                    elem.connected_idx[elem.num_connections] = neighbor_idx;\n                    elem.connected_flux[elem.num_connections] = 1.0;\n                    elem.num_connections++;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Set corner elements as inflow/outflow to create interesting dynamics\n    const int last = n_elems_root - 1;\n    world.elements_static[0 * n_elems_root + 0].material_idx = INFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    world.elements_static[0 * n_elems_root + last].material_idx = OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    world.elements_static[last * n_elems_root + 0].material_idx = OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    world.elements_static[last * n_elems_root + last].material_idx = INFLOW_MAT_ID;\n}\n\n// Compute energy flux between two elements\ninline val_t computeFlux(const Material& mat, const ElementDynamic& this_elem,\n                        val_t connection_flux, const ElementDynamic& other_elem) {\n    return (other_elem.current_energy - this_elem.current_energy) * \n           mat.transfer_coeff * connection_flux * 0.25;\n}\n\n// Run simulation for n_iters iterations\nvoid runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters) {\n    const size_t n_elems = world.elements_static.size();\n    \n    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {\n        // Update all elements\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < n_elems; ++i) {\n            const ElementStatic& elem_static = world.elements_static[i];\n            const ElementDynamic& elem_dyn = world.elements_dynamic[i];\n            const Material& mat = world.materials[elem_static.material_idx];\n            \n            // Start with external flow\n            val_t total_flux = mat.external_flow;\n            \n            // Add flux from all connected elements\n            for (idx_t j = 0; j < elem_static.num_connections; ++j) {\n                const idx_t neighbor_idx = elem_static.connected_idx[j];\n                const ElementDynamic& neighbor_dyn = world.elements_dynamic[neighbor_idx];\n                total_flux += computeFlux(mat, elem_dyn, elem_static.connected_flux[j], neighbor_dyn);\n            }\n            \n            // Update element state\n            ElementDynamic& elem_write = world.elements_dynamic_swap[i];\n            elem_write.current_energy = elem_dyn.current_energy + total_flux;\n            elem_write.total_flux = elem_dyn.total_flux + std::abs(total_flux);\n        }\n        \n        // Swap buffers\n        std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);\n    }\n}\n\n// Validate simulation results\nbool validateResults(const World& world) {\n    val_t energy_sum = 0.0;\n    val_t flux_sum = 0.0;\n    val_t energy_max = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t energy_min = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    \n    for (const auto& elem : world.elements_dynamic) {\n        energy_sum += elem.current_energy;\n        flux_sum += elem.total_flux;\n        energy_max = std::max(elem.current_energy, energy_max);\n        energy_min = std::min(elem.current_energy, energy_min);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Validation results:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  Energy sum: %.12f\\n\", energy_sum);\n    printf(\"  Flux sum: %.2f\\n\", flux_sum);\n    printf(\"  Energy range: [%.6f, %.6f]\\n\", energy_min, energy_max);\n    \n    // Check for numerical issues\n    constexpr val_t energy_epsilon = 1e-8;\n    \n    if (!std::isfinite(energy_sum)) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: Energy sum is not     for (int n = 0; n < 4; ++n) {\n                const int nx = x + offsets[n][0];\n                const int ny = y + offsets[n][1];\n                \n                // Check if neighbor is    }\n\n    energy[i] = elems[i].current_energy;\n    total_flux[i] = elems[i].total_flux;\n}\n\n// Merge energy and flux arrays back into the array-of-structs dynamic state\n__global__ void return;\n    }\n\n    const Material mat = mesh.materials[mesh.material_idx[i]];\n    const val_t this_energy = energy_in[i];\n    const uint32_t n_conn = mesh.num_connections[i];\n\n    // Start with external flow\n    val_t flux = mat.external_flow;\n\n    // Add flux from all connected elements\n    for (uint32_t j = 0; j < n_conn; ++j) {\n        const size_t slot = j * n_elems + i;\n        const uint32_t neighbor_idx = mesh.connected_idx[slot];\n        flux += computeFlux(mat, this_energy, mesh.connected_flux[slot], energy_in[neighbor_idx]);\n    }\n\n    // Update element state\n    energy_out[i] = this_energy + flux;\n    total_flux[i] += fabs(flux);\n}\n\n// Run simulation for n_iters iterations on the GPU\nvoid runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters) {\n    const size_t n_elems = world.elements_static.size();\n    if (n_iters <= 0 || n_elems == 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n    const size_t n_slots = MAX_CONNECTIONS * n_elems;\n    const size_t n_materials = world.materials.size();\n\n    // Upload the host arrays as-is; the layout conversion happens on the device\n    ElementStatic* d_elems_static = nullptr;\n    ElementDynamic* d_elems_dynamic = CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_energy[1], n_elems * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_total_flux, n_elems * sizeof(val_t)));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_elems_static, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    mesh.materials = d_materials;\n\n    constexpr unsigned BLOCK_SIZE = 256;\n    const unsigned grid_size = static_cast<unsigned>((n_elems + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / BLOCK_SIZE);\n\n    // Convert the uploaded data into the device layouts\n    scatterStatic<<<grid_size, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(d_elems_static, mesh, n_elems);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    scatterDynamic<<<grid_size, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(d_elems_dynamic, d_energy[0], d_total_flux, n_elems);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_elems_static));\n\n    // Each step reads one energy buffer and writes the other, then they swap\n    val_t* energy_in = d_energy[0];\n    val_t* energy_out = d_energy[1];\n    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {\n        updateElements<<<grid_size, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(mesh, energy_in, energy_out, d_total_flux, n_elems);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        std::swap(energy_in, energy_out);\n    }\n\n    // Merge the final state back into the array-of-structs layout and download it\n    gatherDynamic<<<grid_size, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(energy_in, d_total_flux, d_elems_dynamic, n_elems);\n CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_elems_dynamic));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_materials));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(mesh.material_idx));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(mesh.num_connections));\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfzhMcDsAwrjDk6XuLBQS","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The simulation now runs on the GPU, and its output matches the original CPU program exactly, including the result hashes, across the configurations I tested.\n\n**What changed** (only `unstructured/unstructured.cpp` and `unstructured/CMakeLists.txt`; no new files, executable name unchanged)\n\n- **Kernel:** one thread per element per iteration. Energy is double-buffered between two device arrays, and the flux accumulator is updated in place.\n- **Layout:** the static mesh is converted on the device into structure-of-arrays with slot-major connectivity, so neighbouring threads read neighbouring addresses. Indices are 32-bit on the device, which always fits because the element count comes from an `int` square.\n- **Arithmetic order:** the flux sums keep the original order, so results are bit-identical.\n- **Unconditional:** there is no CPU fallback or `#ifdef`. Any CUDA error prints a message and exits with status 1.\n- **CMake:** the project now enables `CUDA`, compiles `unstructured.cpp` as CUDA via a source property (so the file is not renamed), and targets sm_75 through sm_90. Host flags are kept.\n\n**Verification**\n\n- Compared against the original CPU build for 512×512 (10 iterations), 37×37, 1×1, 2×2, 5×5, 100×100, 333×333, 1024×1024, and a zero-iteration run. Every non-timing line matched, including the `Result hash` and the `RESULTS` hash.\n- Clean build with `-Wall -Wextra` produces no warnings.\n\n**Performance** (RTX 3090, `Computation time`)\n\n| Config | CPU (original) | GPU |\n|---|---|---|\n| 512², 10 iters (default) | 22 ms | 27 ms |\n| 512², 100 iters | 233 ms | 32 ms |\n| 512², 1000 iters | 2307 ms | 62 ms |\n| 1024², 100 iters | 970 ms | 113 ms |\n| 2048², 100 iters | 3886 ms | 340 ms |\n\nThe timed region covers the upload, the iterations and the download, because those are the cost of running the simulation on the GPU. CUDA context creation happens before the timer starts.\n\n**Things to know**\n\n- At the default 10 iterations the GPU is about the same speed as the CPU. Most of the time is fixed cost: moving roughly 41 MB across PCIe and setting up buffers. The iteration kernel itself takes about 35 µs.\n- The fixed cost is higher in normal runs than under `nsys`. Under `nsys` the program reports 7–8 ms, but about 20 ms appears in the first host-to-device copy when run without the profiler. I could not pin that down, and I did not add a warm-up to hide it.\n- `World::elements_dynamic_swap` is still allocated and filled on the host but is no longer used by the simulation. I left it so the host data structures are unchanged.\n- This repo is not a git repository, so I made no commit."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":894,"cache_read_input_tokens":97409,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":894},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"8fc9f399-7a21-45c8-b253-4b74f669084e","uuid":"5b37109e-291f-46a1-8c1b-8b37324b0088","timestamp":"2026-10-13T18:18:36.144Z","request_id":"req_011CfzhMbQkr5J1xoZ1Yadpi"}
